# FILE LABEL

Set the label of the data file.

## Syntax

```text
FILE LABEL text.
```

The text needs no quotes; a label that starts with a quote is read as a quoted string.

## Example

```text
FILE LABEL Survey wave 2, cleaned.
```

`statscraft help FILE LABEL` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
